The Trajectory: The Path of Reckoning.
When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Greater Evil. The system is contracting due to lack of capacity.

The Unavoidable Truth: The prison system is at capacity because of decades of underinvestment.
